prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign in to safe-keep your pet and access it across devices."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Pick your favorite companion"]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Drag to move around your screen. Right-click for options. Press Ctrl+Shift+P to hide or summon anytime.", "Got It!", "Desktop Quick Shortcuts", "Right-click: Context Menu | Drag: Move | Double-click: Pet options"]
3: ["Clear high-contrast photos work best for desktop pet conversion.", "Previewing Your Custom Companion", "We checked your image quality. Looks great! Confirm or try another photo.", "Looks Great!", "Re-upload Photo"]
4: ["Sign in with your main email to keep existing pets synced safely. Avoid creating duplicate accounts."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Deployment...", "Rendering pet assets...", "Did you know?", "Your pet can wander around windows or sit comfortably on top of your active apps!"]
6: ["Select Your Path & Claim Free Starter Items", "Includes Free Desktop Toy Pack!"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look at the bottom right corner of your main monitor. If hidden behind windows, click the tray icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P.", "Say Hello!"]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Universe", "Adopt, customize, and play with companions that live right on your screen while you work.", "Your pet reacts to your cursor, plays with items, and keeps you company."]
9: ["Official Desktop Adoption Certificate", "Give Your Pet a Name", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
